\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{દરમિયાન} (darmiyān)}{દરમિયાન (darmiyān)}]{\gu{દરમિયાન} (darmiyān) — during}

\label{lesson:GU-C316-darmiyan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for a mention, then the Gujarati for to behold.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{દરમિયાન}}
\textbf{\gu{દરમિયાન}} — \emph{darmiyān} — \textquotedblleft{}during\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{વરસાદ} \gu{દરમિયાન} \gu{વીજળી} \gu{ગઈ}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{varsād darmiyān vījḷī gaī.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The power went off during the rain.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{દરમિયાન}} (\emph{darmiyān}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{darmiyān}, \textquotedblleft{}in the middle, between\textquotedblright{}. It follows its noun: \textbf{\gu{વરસાદ} \gu{દરમિયાન}}, during the rain.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{darmiyān}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{darmiyān}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{varsād darmiyān vījḷī gaī.} — The power went off during the rain.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for a mention, then the Gujarati for to behold, then say \emph{darmiyān} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \gu{દરમિયાન} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}During\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{હાલ} (hāl)}{હાલ (hāl)}]{\gu{હાલ} (hāl) — at present}

\label{lesson:GU-C316-hal}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for to behold, then the Gujarati for during.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{હાલ}}
\textbf{\gu{હાલ}} — \emph{hāl} — \textquotedblleft{}at present\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{હાલ} \gu{તે} \gu{દવાખાનામાં} \gu{છે}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{hāl te davākhānāmā̃ che.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
At present he is in hospital.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{હાલ}} (\emph{hāl}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{ḥāl}, \textquotedblleft{}a state, the present\textquotedblright{}, the word behind \textbf{\gu{હાલત}}. It is the news word for \textquotedblleft{}now\textquotedblright{}: \textbf{\gu{હાલ} \gu{તે} \gu{સલામત} \gu{છે}}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hāl}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hāl}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hāl te davākhānāmā̃ che.} — At present he is in hospital.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for to behold, then the Gujarati for during, then say \emph{hāl} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{મુજબ} (mujab)}{મુજબ (mujab)}]{\gu{મુજબ} (mujab) — according to}

\label{lesson:GU-C316-mujab}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for during, then the Gujarati for at present.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{મુજબ}}
\textbf{\gu{મુજબ}} — \emph{mujab} — \textquotedblleft{}according to\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{છાપાના} \gu{અહેવાલ} \gu{મુજબ} \gu{ચાર} \gu{લોકો} \gu{ઘાયલ} \gu{થયા}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{chāpānā ahevāl mujab cār loko ghāyal thayā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
According to the newspaper report, four people were hurt.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{મુજબ}} (\emph{mujab}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{mūjib}, \textquotedblleft{}a cause, a ground\textquotedblright{}. It follows its noun: \textbf{\gu{અહેવાલ} \gu{મુજબ}}, according to the report.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mujab}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mujab}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{chāpānā ahevāl mujab cār loko ghāyal thayā.} — According to the newspaper report, four people were hurt.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for during, then the Gujarati for at present, then say \emph{mujab} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{ગુપ્ત} (gupt)}{ગુપ્ત (gupt)}]{\gu{ગુપ્ત} (gupt) — secret}

\label{lesson:GU-C316-gupt}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for at present, then the Gujarati for according to.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{ગુપ્ત}}
\textbf{\gu{ગુપ્ત}} — \emph{gupt} — \textquotedblleft{}secret\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{પોલીસે} \gu{આ} \gu{માહિતી} \gu{ગુપ્ત} \gu{રાખી}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{polīse ā māhitī gupt rākhī.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The police kept this information secret.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{ગુપ્ત}} (\emph{gupt}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{gupta}, \textquotedblleft{}protected, guarded\textquotedblright{}, and so \textquotedblleft{}hidden\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams). A thing is kept secret with \textbf{\gu{રાખવું}}: \textbf{\gu{ગુપ્ત} \gu{રાખી}}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gupt}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gupt}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{polīse ā māhitī gupt rākhī.} — The police kept this information secret.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for at present, then the Gujarati for according to, then say \emph{gupt} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{ટકવું} (ṭakvũ)}{ટકવું (ṭakvũ)}]{\gu{ટકવું} (ṭakvũ) — to last; to hold out}

\label{lesson:GU-C316-takvu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for according to, then the Gujarati for secret.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{ટકવું}}
\textbf{\gu{ટકવું}} — \emph{ṭakvũ} — \textquotedblleft{}to last; to hold out\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{હડતાળ} \gu{ત્રણ} \gu{દિવસ} \gu{ટકી}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{haḍtāḷ traṇ divas ṭakī.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The strike lasted three days.
\end{quote}

Past (it …): \gu{તે} \gu{મકાન} \gu{ટક્યું}, \emph{te makān ṭakyũ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{ટકવું}} (\emph{ṭakvũ}) comes from \emph{*ṭakk}, a form CDIAL reconstructs, where it lists Gujarati \emph{ṭakvũ}, \textquotedblleft{}to stop\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 5420); today it is to stay standing, to last: \textbf{\gu{ત્રણ} \gu{દિવસ} \gu{ટકી}}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ṭakvũ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{haḍtāḷ traṇ divas ṭakī.} — The strike lasted three days.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for according to, then the Gujarati for secret, then say \emph{ṭakvũ} again
\end{itemize}

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from An Award for Courage to According to the Report}

\label{lesson:GU-R316-review-309-316}



\begin{quote}
Say the Gujarati for an assembly and an honour.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an assembly, an honour, a prize, to applaud, pride
  \item a squad, deadly, assistance, to be at a loss, to disperse
  \item the news, a newspaper, a headline, a radio, to inform
  \item a journalist, an incident, a case (to tell), a report, to describe
  \item a rumour, to spread (something), the truth, information, word (of something)
  \item a strike, a protest march, a slogan, a speech, to resound
  \item an inauguration, an occasion, a site, a mention, to behold
  \item during, at present, according to, secret, to last
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An assembly? (\textbf{\gu{સભા}}, \emph{sabhā}.) An honour? (\textbf{\gu{સન્માન}}, \emph{sanmān}.) A prize? (\textbf{\gu{ઇનામ}}, \emph{inām}.) To applaud? (\textbf{\gu{બિરદાવવું}}, \emph{birdāvvũ}.) Pride? (\textbf{\gu{ગર્વ}}, \emph{garva}.) A squad? (\textbf{\gu{ટુકડી}}, \emph{ṭukḍī}.) Deadly? (\textbf{\gu{જીવલેણ}}, \emph{jīvleṇ}.) Assistance? (\textbf{\gu{સહાય}}, \emph{sahāy}.) To be at a loss? (\textbf{\gu{મૂંઝાવું}}, \emph{mū̃jhāvũ}.) To disperse? (\textbf{\gu{વિખેરાવું}}, \emph{vikherāvũ}.) The news? (\textbf{\gu{સમાચાર}}, \emph{samācār}.) A newspaper? (\textbf{\gu{છાપું}}, \emph{chāpũ}.) A headline? (\textbf{\gu{મથાળું}}, \emph{mathāḷũ}.) A radio? (\textbf{\gu{રેડિયો}}, \emph{reḍiyo}.) To inform? (\textbf{\gu{જણાવવું}}, \emph{jaṇāvvũ}.) A journalist? (\textbf{\gu{પત્રકાર}}, \emph{patrakār}.) An incident? (\textbf{\gu{ઘટના}}, \emph{ghaṭnā}.) A case (to tell)? (\textbf{\gu{કિસ્સો}}, \emph{kisso}.) A report? (\textbf{\gu{અહેવાલ}}, \emph{ahevāl}.) To describe? (\textbf{\gu{વર્ણવવું}}, \emph{varṇavvũ}.) A rumour? (\textbf{\gu{અફવા}}, \emph{aphvā}.) To spread (something)? (\textbf{\gu{ફેલાવવું}}, \emph{phelāvvũ}.) The truth? (\textbf{\gu{સત્ય}}, \emph{satya}.) Information? (\textbf{\gu{માહિતી}}, \emph{māhitī}.) Word (of something)? (\textbf{\gu{ખબર}}, \emph{khabar}.) A strike? (\textbf{\gu{હડતાળ}}, \emph{haḍtāḷ}.) A protest march? (\textbf{\gu{મોરચો}}, \emph{morco}.) A slogan? (\textbf{\gu{સૂત્ર}}, \emph{sūtra}.) A speech? (\textbf{\gu{પ્રવચન}}, \emph{pravacan}.) To resound? (\textbf{\gu{ગુંજવું}}, \emph{gunjvũ}.) An inauguration? (\textbf{\gu{ઉદ્ઘાટન}}, \emph{udghāṭan}.) An occasion? (\textbf{\gu{પ્રસંગ}}, \emph{prasang}.) A site? (\textbf{\gu{સ્થળ}}, \emph{sthaḷ}.) A mention? (\textbf{\gu{ઉલ્લેખ}}, \emph{ullekh}.) To behold? (\textbf{\gu{નિહાળવું}}, \emph{nihāḷvũ}.) During? (\textbf{\gu{દરમિયાન}}, \emph{darmiyān}.) At present? (\textbf{\gu{હાલ}}, \emph{hāl}.) According to? (\textbf{\gu{મુજબ}}, \emph{mujab}.) Secret? (\textbf{\gu{ગુપ્ત}}, \emph{gupt}.) To last? (\textbf{\gu{ટકવું}}, \emph{ṭakvũ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
